evaluation_protocol: Teacher-forced cross-entropy loss computed on reference target summaries
interpretation_note: Teacher-forced perplexity measures language model fluency on target summaries; generation fidelity must be evaluated independently via ROUGE and clinical fact retention.
tokenizer_comparability_note: Because Qwen2 (151k vocab) and SmolLM2 (49k vocab) employ different tokenizers, token-level perplexities are accompanied by Byte-Normalized Bits-Per-Byte (BPB), which normalizes total cross-entropy over identical target UTF-8 bytes (641,050 bytes), substantially reducing the direct effect of tokenizer granularity. Fine-Tuned Qwen achieves the lowest entropy across both token PPL (3.85) and byte BPB (0.388).
